name: Bookkeeper Task Pack - CentreCanada
description: Task definitions for the Accounting Bookkeeper role, mirroring sections 4, 5 and 11 of the job description 'Gorev Tanimi - Muhasebe ve Defter Tutma Sorumlusu (Bookkeeper)'. Import into Recurring Task Manager. Ad-hoc tasks (purchases requested by the Mali Heyet or Executive Director, audit document requests, new grant data, regulation-driven work) are created in the app as they arise. Communication: incoming cash is posted to the 'Nakit Alinanlar' WhatsApp group, questions are asked in the 'Mali Heyet Sorular ve Cevaplar' group, and approvals are given by the designated Mali Heyet member or the Executive Director. Work split with the CPA: the CPA files payroll, T4/T4A, GST/HST/PST, WorkSafeBC and T3010; the bookkeeper prepares and delivers the data packages and tracks the CPA deadlines. Document coordination: the bookkeeper is the single responsible person for preparing financial documents (from QuickBooks or obtained from the CPA) and sending them to banks, funders, government bodies and management.

definitions.title: Record cash receipts and payments
definitions.note: Post each incoming cash amount to the 'Nakit Alinanlar' WhatsApp group on the same day and record it in the accounting system (no receipt is issued for cash collections). Record outgoing cash payments too.

definitions.title: Process incoming invoices and financial requests
definitions.note: Review incoming vendor invoices and financial emails and enter them into the accounting system.

definitions.title: Petty cash recording
definitions.note: Record petty cash transactions and reconcile the float.

definitions.title: Record fundraising event income (kermes, bazaars)
definitions.note: On event days only: post all income collected at fundraising events (kermes, bazaars) to the 'Nakit Alinanlar' WhatsApp group and record it in the accounting system on the same day.

definitions.title: Update task statuses
definitions.note: Keep task statuses on the bookkeeping task board up to date and mark completed tasks.

definitions.title: Weekly pledge report
definitions.note: Prepare the weekly pledge report showing who paid how much and how much remains, and share it with the relevant groups.

definitions.title: Review pending invoices and payment list
definitions.note: Check invoices and payments nearing their due dates and give early warnings.

definitions.title: Run approved vendor payments
definitions.note: Execute vendor payments only after approval from the finance committee (Mali Heyet) or the Executive Director.

definitions.title: Respond to financial document requests
definitions.note: Prepare the financial documents requested by banks, funders, government bodies or management: pull data from QuickBooks or obtain documents from the CPA, send them to the requester and log what was sent.

definitions.title: Prepare weekly report
definitions.note: Short weekly summary of completed entries, pending invoices and payments, reconciliation status, grant statuses and task statuses, for the Executive Director and the Mali Heyet representative.

definitions.title: Enter work hours
definitions.note: Enter hours worked into the system.

definitions.title: Prepare and send payroll data to CPA
definitions.note: The CPA processes payroll. Send hours, wages, leave and change data to the CPA each period, record the processed payroll in QuickBooks and reconcile the payroll accounts.

definitions.title: Verify CPA payroll remittances
definitions.note: Track that the CPA sends source deductions (CPP, EI, tax) and employer portions on time, and verify the records.

definitions.title: Bank account reconciliation
definitions.note: Compare every transaction on all bank statements with the QuickBooks records one by one, investigate and correct differences, and verify period-end balances.

definitions.title: Credit card reconciliation
definitions.note: Match every credit and debit card payment on the statements individually to its expense entry in QuickBooks, verify dates and amounts, and file the reconciliation documents.

definitions.title: Monthly financial statements
definitions.note: Prepare the income-expense report, budget comparison and cash position for the Executive Director.

definitions.title: Department budget report
definitions.note: Prepare and share the per-department planned, actual and remaining budget report.

definitions.title: Monthly grant report
definitions.note: Produce the monthly report showing each grant's total amount, spent and remaining portions.

definitions.title: Program income and collections report (weekend school, Future Bridge Academy)
definitions.note: Track parent payments and expenses of the weekend school, Future Bridge Academy and similar programs; ensure collections are completed and report income, expenses and outstanding balances.

definitions.title: Update GST accounts for income-generating activities
definitions.note: Keep the GST accounts of every income-generating activity separate and current: determine GST applicability and track collected and paid GST separately.

definitions.title: Reconcile online donation platforms
definitions.note: Reconcile online donation platform and e-transfer reports with QuickBooks and the bank; match donor lists to the accounting records and resolve name and amount differences.

definitions.title: Issue donation receipts and update the register
definitions.note: Issue official donation receipts (tax receipts) to donors, keep the register complete (donor, date, amount, advantage value) and follow the CRA receipting rules.

definitions.title: Monthly regular payments (bursaries, rents, staff funds)
definitions.note: Make regular payments on time: student bursaries and supplements, employee funds, rents and similar. Prepare the required official documents for student bursaries (T4A where applicable) and keep complete records.

definitions.title: Process reimbursements
definitions.note: Process and pay employee and volunteer expense reimbursements against receipts.

definitions.title: Collect and upload officials' fund spending documents
definitions.note: Collect the spending documents for funds given to officials, upload them to the system, learn the formality requirements and ensure the payments follow them.

definitions.title: Invoice and track tenant rent
definitions.note: Issue the monthly rent invoices to tenants, record payments and follow up on overdue rent. Record the GST/HST treatment according to the lease (commercial or residential).

definitions.title: Track mortgage payments
definitions.note: Record mortgage payments with the principal / interest split according to the payment schedule provided by the CPA.

definitions.title: Record building maintenance and operating expenses
definitions.note: Record maintenance, repairs, insurance, property tax and operating expenses separately for the building.

definitions.title: Track building utilities and lease notices
definitions.note: Record utility bills (hydro, gas, water) per building, track rent increase and tenant notice dates, and keep tenant security deposits separate.

definitions.title: Monthly review report
definitions.note: Monthly evaluation for the Executive Director and the Mali Heyet representative: reconciliations, statements, department budget reports, grant reports, cash position and next month priorities.

definitions.title: Prepare GST/HST working papers for CPA
definitions.note: Prepare the GST/HST working data for the period and send it to the CPA at least one week before the deadline; track that the CPA files and pays by the deadline.

definitions.title: Prepare PST working papers for CPA
definitions.note: Prepare the PST working data for the period and send it to the CPA; track that the CPA files and pays on time.

definitions.title: Board financial summary
definitions.note: Compile financial summaries for board and committee meetings.

definitions.title: Budget review
definitions.note: Review department budget actuals and report variances.

definitions.title: Verify CPA WorkSafeBC quarterly filing
definitions.note: Track that the CPA files the standard quarterly WorkSafeBC payroll report and pays the premium on time (quarterly reporting is the standard requirement).

definitions.title: Year-end closing
definitions.note: Support year-end closing and coordinate with the external accountant.

definitions.title: Prepare T4/T4A data for CPA
definitions.note: Prepare the employee, wage, deduction and student bursary data for the T4/T4A summaries and send it to the CPA; track that the CPA files on time.

definitions.title: Prepare T3010 data pack for CPA
definitions.note: Prepare the draft data set and supporting reports for the T3010 return according to the CPA's checklist and deliver it at least one month before the deadline; track that the CPA files on time.

definitions.title: Request CPA data checklist and confirm with Mali Heyet
definitions.note: At the start of the year, request the annual data checklist from the CPA as a defined task, have the Mali Heyet review and confirm the list, and schedule every delivery deadline in this task manager.

definitions.title: Audit / review support
definitions.note: Prepare the documents and samples requested for the financial audit / review.

definitions.title: Verify CPA WorkSafeBC annual reconciliation
definitions.note: Verify that the CPA completed the annual WorkSafeBC payroll reconciliation, reported the actual annual payroll and settled any premium difference.

definitions.title: Annual budget data
definitions.note: Prepare the financial data for the next year's budget cycle.

definitions.title: Building income-expense summary for CPA
definitions.note: Prepare the annual building income and expense summary (rent income, GST treatment, mortgage principal / interest, operating expenses) and send it to the CPA.

definitions.title: Prepare donor summary letters
definitions.note: Prepare and send the year-end donor summary letters.

definitions.title: Update fixed asset register
definitions.note: Update the fixed asset register: building, furniture and equipment.

definitions.title: Support annual budget preparation
definitions.note: Provide data support to departments and gather draft figures for the annual budget cycle (developed over time).

definitions.title: Record retention and archive review
definitions.note: Check document retention periods and organize the archives.
